result.summary: Adds sync and lookup microbenchmarks for TxIndex, TxoSpenderIndex, and BlockFilterIndex, backed by shared utilities that generate synthetic blocks with chained spends and distinct output scripts. Also adds documentation to doc/benchmarking.md explaining how to measure I/O syscalls, peak resident memory, and disk usage using -testdatadir.
result.problem: Evaluating performance changes to the index subsystem previously required running a full initial block download (IBD). The only existing index benchmark, BlockFilterIndexSync, only processes blocks containing coinbase transactions, leaving no benchmarks for TxIndex or TxoSpenderIndex and no way to measure index scaling against transaction counts or distinct script outputs.
evidence: PR description: The author notes that evaluating index changes previously required a full IBD, whereas this benchmark suite runs in under a minute.
PR description: The author demonstrates its utility on PR #35531 (showing a 49% smaller index vs lookup regression) and PR #34489 (showing a 91% reduction in write syscalls with unchanged CPU).
result.scope_notes: Touches only benchmark harnesses (src/bench/) and developer benchmarking documentation.
result.changed_since_previous: Patch-id changed with minor adjustments; the overall commit structure, benchmark targets, and documentation additions remain unchanged from the previous version.
result.card: Adds sync and lookup benchmarks for TxIndex, TxoSpenderIndex, and realistic BlockFilterIndex workloads, along with documentation on measuring benchmark I/O and peak memory. Previously, the only index benchmark synced coinbase-only blocks, and evaluating performance changes to indices required a full IBD. The author demonstrated its utility on two recent PRs (#35531 and #34489) to quantify disk usage, lookup latency regressions, and a 91% reduction in write syscalls.

risk.why: A flaw in the benchmark code or documentation could yield inaccurate metrics or break the benchmark harness, but cannot affect node runtime or consensus behavior.
